approach: The drain already gives each item two attempts per run. This plan adds a hold that works across items and runs. The scope guard gets a count of the attempts on a line that did not land. It groups lines with the existing `group_lines` and `line_attempts`. It counts Rejected and Failed attempts. It also counts a job that closed Landed locally but whose pull-request link (own or early, `load_link_any`) has a state other than Landed and which has no landing record. Either a Landed link state or a landing record removes a job from that set. `request_records` becomes a wrapper over a new `request_records_with`. Only the hold passes the "not taken by the host" predicate, so an unlanded job stops closing its text line. The T1 to T5 callers keep the wrapper. `Steps` gets a defaulted `held` method, and `RealSteps::held` calls the new `Athena::line_holds`, which loads the records once. `Drain::prepare` treats a held item like a paused one. In `Drain::attempts` the hold is checked at the top of the `if passed.is_none()` block, after `paused_reason`, and in the `failures >= ATTEMPTS` branch after the paused and flagged checks, so the item whose own second failure starts the hold also ends as 'awaiting diagnosis'. The item's own landing retry runs only when `passed` is `Some`, so it is never held. Nothing is written and no diagnosis job is queued (a follow-up). The scope-guard tests that need two jobs that both change the file use a NEW rig constructor `rig_counting`; the shared `rig` is untouched. Drain tests use the real `drain::drain` and `drain::plan` through `RealSteps` on real records, with only the lander and the fake agent doubled.

decisions.choice: Count a line's non-landed attempts as verdict Rejected or Failed (as T1 does; Environment excluded), plus jobs closed Landed locally whose link (own or early, via load_link_any) state is not Landed and which have no landing record. Hold at HOLD_ATTEMPTS = 2.
decisions.reason: `go` records a local Landed outcome before the drain's pull-request landing, so a collision job reads as Accepted in the records and closes its text line (scope_guard.rs:648-657). Only the link's state field (pr.rs:27-36) says whether the host took it. Early links are included, because Athena opens the pull request early (system facts) and `load_link_any` (pr.rs:151-156) falls back to the early link. Only a job with no link at all (no pull request ever opened) is treated as landed, which errs towards retrying.

rejected.option: Decide 'taken by the host' from link-file existence plus a missing landing record
rejected.why: Landing records come from the local records branch and read as empty when it is missing, so jobs that did land would count as unlanded. The link state is the authority.
A collision job is Closed(Landed) locally, so it would never reach the threshold (first-round finding).
Blocked means local edits refused the fast-forward and `go` retries it. It is not a failure of the work.

decisions.choice: `request_records_with(records, unlanded)` is the real function; `request_records(records)` stays as a wrapper passing `|_| false`. `attempt_of` maps Accepted to Failed when the predicate says the job is unlanded.
decisions.reason: The hold needs an unlanded job to count as an attempt and not close its text line. The signal callers (`line_pause` 784, `line_flag`, `live_marks`, `try_watch_line`) keep the wrapper, so T1 to T5 and pauses do not change.

rejected.why: It would change T1 to T5 and pause results for lines with pull-request links; out of scope.
Verdict is matched in `counted`, T4 and the marks; that touches signal code.

decisions.choice: Hold check in `Drain::attempts` at three places: (a) inside `if passed.is_none()` right after `paused_reason` (drain.rs:1919); (b) in the `failures >= ATTEMPTS` branch (drain.rs:1986) in the order paused, flagged, held, else Failed; (c) merged into the `Drain::prepare` held map (drain.rs:2170-2249). Never outside `if passed.is_none()` at the top.
decisions.reason: (a) Once a job has passed, the loop skips that block, so the free landing retry of the item's own blocked job (drain.rs:1971-1983) is never refused (criterion 4). (b) Answers finding 3: the item whose own second failure creates the hold is reported 'awaiting diagnosis' and not 'failed twice'. Putting the hold after flagged keeps the existing real-steps flag tests (tests/drain.rs:5966, 6014), which expect 'is flagged', unchanged. An environment stop needs no extra check: `verdict_of` maps it to Environment, which is not counted, so such an item has count < 2 and still ends `ItemEnd::Failed` and sets Stop::Environment at drain.rs:2634-2639. (c) stops a held item being read to fill its plan and lists it in `plan`.

rejected.option: Check at the top of every loop iteration
rejected.why: It would refuse the landing retry of the item's own just-verified job.
`prepare` would still pay to read a held item's plan.

rejected.option: Put the hold before the flagged check in the failures branch
rejected.why: It would change the 'is flagged' passed-over text that existing RealSteps tests assert.

decisions.choice: `Steps::held(&self, jobs) -> Vec<(String,String)>` with a default returning nothing. `RealSteps::held` loads the records once and calls `Athena::line_holds`. The hold is derived from the records each time; nothing is written.
decisions.reason: It mirrors `paused` and `flagged`; every existing `impl Steps` compiles and behaves as before. A derived hold lifts itself when a link turns Landed or the line is accepted. No file or release step exists to get stuck.

rejected.option: Write a mark file like pause/flag
rejected.why: It needs lifting by hand and adds state (the stuck-claim problem of the earlier attempt).
The refusal text would be wrong, and `go` and `retry` also refuse a paused line, which would block a manual retry.

decisions.choice: A hold stops only the drain. `athena go` and `athena retry` (run/mod.rs:1026, reading.rs:1191) do not call `line_holds`.
decisions.reason: The request is that the drain stops retrying. No new refusal rule is added to readings, so no refusal_corpus case applies.

rejected.why: It adds a reading refusal with no way past it, and is out of scope.

decisions.choice: Add `PrLink::taken_by_host()` (state == LinkState::Landed) and a `LinkState` wording helper in pr.rs. scope_guard.rs calls `taken_by_host`; the hold note in drain.rs matches on `LinkState`.
decisions.reason: One definition of 'the host took it'; criterion 5 is visible in both files.

rejected.option: Compare the state in each caller

decisions.choice: Test-only change to the scope-guard rig: add `rig_counting` (a new constructor, shared body with a `counting` flag) whose fake producer writes README text with a per-call counter. The existing `rig` and `rig_with_space` keep the fixed edit.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 1. `asking_the_words_of_a_landed_request_again_starts_a_new_line` (scope_guard.rs:1377-1387) relies on the identical edit: its comment at 1382 says the second job 'does not land', and 1383 asserts it. Only the new criterion-3 tests need two jobs that both change README.

rejected.option: Put the counter in the shared rig
rejected.why: It would make the second job land and break the existing test at 1377.

decisions.choice: A waiting pull request (Open link, checks not finished) counts as not landed until it is seen merged. The hold note names each unlanded job's pull request and its state, and the CHANGELOG says so.
decisions.reason: Finding 4 fallback. The link file stores no checks state, and the drain's Waiting result (drain.rs:1875-1880, 3426-3439) is not recorded anywhere the records-derived hold can read. A Waiting item is not retried by the drain anyway (ItemEnd::Waiting). The hold lifts by itself when the link turns Landed.

rejected.option: Persist the drain's last landing result per job
rejected.why: New state outside the records, which the plan avoids; a follow-up if waiting jobs prove to cause false holds.

decisions.choice: Do not queue a diagnosis job. The hold note and CHANGELOG name diagnosis as not built yet.
decisions.reason: The accepted reading narrows the change to the hold. It also avoids the cost-filing and paused-line problems raised on the earlier attempt.

rejected.why: Out of scope by the reading.

risks.risk: A job whose pull request is waiting on checks has an Open link and no landing record, so it counts as an unlanded attempt until it merges. One rejection plus one merging job holds the line (finding 4).
risks.mitigation: The link file stores no checks state and the drain's Waiting result is not recorded, so the count cannot tell a waiting job from a collision. The hold is derived each time and lifts by itself when the link turns Landed. The hold note names each unlanded job's pull request number and state, and the CHANGELOG says a waiting pull request counts until it is seen merged. The drain never retried a Waiting item anyway. Persisting the last landing result is a named follow-up.

risks.risk: Corrected from the earlier plan: an off-branch or other NotLanded in a pull-request setup does leave a link, because Athena opens the pull request early and `load_link_any` reads the early link. Only a job with no link at all (no pull request opened) is treated as landed.
risks.mitigation: Jobs with an early link are counted, which is the right count. A job with no link at all is not held, which errs towards retrying as today and never invents a hold. The CHANGELOG states this and does not claim that an off-branch refusal leaves no link.

risks.risk: The hold counts Rejected and Failed the way T1 does, which includes TimedOut, Stale, Abandoned and Dropped jobs that `verdict_of` maps to Failed.
risks.mitigation: It reuses the scope guard's own classification and keeps Environment stops out (scope_guard.rs:544-556), so an environment cause still ends the run through the unchanged `Failed` path. No new classifier is added.

risks.risk: `line_holds` reads a link for every Closed(Landed) job without a landing record while building the requests; on a repository from before the cutover that is many small reads per call.
risks.mitigation: The landing-record set is built once first and the link is read only for jobs outside it. A missing file is a cheap NotFound, the records are loaded once per `held` call, and a read error counts as 'not unlanded', the safe direction.

risks.risk: Two workers under `max_concurrency` > 1 can start two items of one line before either fails, so the hold can overrun by one attempt.
risks.mitigation: The hold is checked at attempt start and in `prepare`, which runs again after each group. Accepted; the scope-guard pause has the same race.

risks.risk: Because `go` and `retry` do not check the hold, a held line stays held for the drain until a link turns Landed or the request words change.
risks.mitigation: This is the stated goal: the drain stops. The hold note says what clears it. Diagnosis and a release command are named follow-ups.

risks.risk: A flagged line used to dispatch every item; a line that is flagged and also has two non-landed attempts now holds its next item.
risks.mitigation: This is the requested stop. The drain.rs module doc and the `Steps::flagged` doc are updated to say so. The existing real-steps flag tests use one item and the failures-branch order keeps their 'is flagged' text.

risks.risk: The criterion 1 test queues three requests with the same words, and the queue could merge them or the fake producer could write identical text, giving a no-op job that does not land for a different reason.
risks.mitigation: The test asserts the queue holds three items before the drain. The `numbered` helper gives every producer call its own README text. Either fault fails the test loudly and does not pass it by accident.

demonstrations.method: New test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. Fixture: `Fixture::new()`, `fx.athena(numbered(Scenario::default().script()))`, and three `queue_steward_request(&athena, T)` calls with the same words T, giving items A, C and D. First assert `steps.queue().items.len() == 3`, so a queue that merged the items fails loudly and not silently. Build `RealSteps { athena, ui, page: &StubPage, lander: &ScriptedLander }` with a ScriptedLander that answers NotLanded every time. Run `drain::drain` with `work_everything()` limits and a line-recording Ui, then `drain::plan`.
demonstrations.observes: A: the first job passes, the lander is called twice (the free landing retry) and answers NotLanded with an Open link. The line has 1 non-landed attempt, so A ends 'failed twice'. C joins A's line (A no longer closes the text line), passes, and the lander is called twice. The line now has 2 non-landed attempts, so C is passed over as 'awaiting diagnosis' by the failures-branch check, not as 'failed twice'. D is passed over at the top of its attempt: no reader, producer or verifier call for D, `records.jobs[D].job` is None, and the lander call count stays 4. The report has no failure for D and `report.stop == Stop::QueueEmpty`. After the run, `drain::plan` lists D (and A and C) in `plan.refused` as held with a reason containing 'awaiting diagnosis', and `plan.order` is empty. A second test in the same file, `a_line_that_was_rejected_once_and_not_landed_once_is_held`, uses `phased(rejecting, default)` and a ScriptedLander answering NotLanded, so one Rejected job plus one collision job reach the threshold.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the hold, D is read and run (agent and lander counts rise) and the plan does not list D as held. Without the grouping change, A closes the text line, C starts a new line, the count stays 1 and nothing is held. With a Rejected/Failed-only count, the line never reaches 2 and the test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: `drain::drain` and `drain::plan` (drain.rs), `RealSteps::held` and `Athena::line_holds`, over real records and real link files. Doubles: the `Lander` trait, injected through `RealSteps.lander` as in tests/drain.rs:2612, and the fake agent from `Fixture::athena(script)`. The new `ScriptedLander` only writes the link file (`athena_core::pr::store_link`, state Open) and returns the scripted answer; it computes no count. The new `numbered` helper only varies the producer's README text per call so every job changes the file. Existing: Fixture, RealSteps, Lander, `queue_steward_request`, `phased`, `rejecting_verdict`, `work_everything`, StubPage. Added by plan step 11: ScriptedLander and `numbered`. `Steps::held` is added by step 8.

demonstrations.method: New test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. Queue one request and run `drain::drain` through `RealSteps` with `phased(first = Scenario{verdict: rejecting_verdict(), ..}, second = Scenario::default())` and `RecordingLander`.
demonstrations.observes: The first job closes Rejected, so the line has 1 non-landed attempt and the hold does not fire. The retry job is read and run and lands through the lander. `report.landed == 1`, `report.jobs` has two lines for the item, and no 'awaiting diagnosis' line is printed.
demonstrations.fails_without: A hold threshold of 1 (or a hold check that counted the item's own first failure) stops the retry; the test then sees `landed == 0` and one job.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `drain::drain` with `RealSteps`. Doubles: the fake agent script from `phased` (exists, tests/drain.rs:4951) with `rejecting_verdict` (exists, line 4932), and `RecordingLander` (exists, line 2556). No new seam.

demonstrations.method: New tests in the `watcher_tests` module of crates/athena-core/src/scope_guard.rs, using the NEW `rig_counting` constructor (step 5) and the existing `Rig::ask` and `Rig::go`, and `Records::load`. (a) Ask the same words twice and `go` both; both close Landed locally. Store an Open `PrLink` for each with `crate::pr::store_link(&rig.athena.state, ...)`. `Athena::line_holds` gives attempts == 2 and a hold for B. (b) Set A's link to `LinkState::Landed` with no landing record: the count is 1 and there is no hold. (c) A has an Open link, and a `Landing` with a `JobLanding` commit naming A is pushed into `records.landings` (shape copied from `landing_of` in the status tests): the count is 1. (d) The `request_records` wrapper still returns Accepted for a Closed(Landed) job with an Open link. (e) A rejected job plus one unlanded job on one line gives 2.
demonstrations.observes: Attempt counts are 2, 1, 1, 1 and 2. A Landed link and a landing record each remove a job from the unlanded set. The wrapper's verdicts are unchanged.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the link-state rule, (b) counts the Landed-link job and returns 2. Without the grouping change, (a) returns 1 because B starts a new line. Without the wrapper, (d) and the T1 to T5 tests would change.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `Athena::line_holds(&self, &Records, &[String])` and the wrapper `request_records`, over records the test loads from the rig's real git repository. Link files are written by the real `pr::store_link`. The landing record in (c) is built by the test from the real record types. Existing: the `rig` machinery (scope_guard.rs:1038). Added by plan steps 4 to 6: `line_holds`, and `rig_counting`, a new constructor so the shared rig's fixed edit stays as it is.

demonstrations.method: New test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs. Queue A and B with the same words. Use `numbered` and a ScriptedLander whose answers are NotLanded, NotLanded (A and its retry), NotLanded (B's first land), then Landed. On Landed it sets B's link to Landed. Run `drain::drain` through `RealSteps`.
demonstrations.observes: After A, the line has 1 non-landed attempt, so B starts. After B's first NotLanded the line has 2 non-landed attempts, yet the free landing retry still runs. The lander is called 4 times, `report.landed == 1`, and no 'awaiting diagnosis' line is printed for B.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the hold check ran outside `if passed.is_none()` or before the second land, B would end 'awaiting diagnosis' after one lander call, and the lander count and `landed` would fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `drain::drain` with `RealSteps`. Double: ScriptedLander, injected through `RealSteps.lander`, which scripts only the land answer and the link file. The hold check itself runs in `Drain::attempts`, where step 8 places it. Existing: RealSteps, `queue_steward_request`, Fixture. Added by step 11: ScriptedLander and `numbered`.

demonstrations.observes: scope_guard.rs calls `PrLink::taken_by_host` (the `state == LinkState::Landed` test, defined in pr.rs) when it decides which jobs are unlanded. drain.rs matches on `LinkState` (Open, MergedUnverified, Landed) in `RealSteps::held` to describe each unlanded job's pull request. Neither file decides from whether a link file exists alone.

One entry under [Unreleased]. It says the drain holds a line after two attempts that did not land, awaiting diagnosis. It says a job with a pull-request link whose state is not Landed and no landing record counts as not landed (early links included; a job with no link at all is treated as landed), and that a waiting pull request counts until it is seen merged. It says the diagnosis job, role and schema, line field and status display are not done here. It makes no other claim. `refusal_corpus` reads CHANGELOG.md by `include_str!` for fixed claim strings (tests/refusal_corpus.rs:966, 1045, 1078, 1574); adding an entry removes none of them.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks on the workspace.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All pass. That covers the existing paused and flagged real-steps tests (tests/drain.rs:5923-6030), the `asking_the_words_of_a_landed_request_again_starts_a_new_line` test (scope_guard.rs:1377, unchanged because the shared rig is unchanged), the `drain --help` test, and the system-facts budget test (no prompt asset changes). No test outside the new ones changes its expectation.
demonstrations.fails_without: A regression in `request_records`, the paused-line text, the flagged text or a `Steps` impl would fail an existing test or the build.
